No normalization gaps, hidden density assumptions or finite-to-infinite inference.

value.rationale: Specifying an infinite continuum of sub-diagonal joint probabilities while permitting arbitrary opposite-corner extremes is a mathematically motivated identification problem for copula-based tail risk. The exact complete two-parameter feasible set, closed-endpoint attainment, and compatibility even when corner squares overlap constitute nontrivial structure not captured by a routine one-sided bound. The independence sub-diagonal is a canonical benchmark, not a capricious numerical slice.
